post.description:
Backfill a registered channel's newest ``limit`` uploads (#41, D9b).

This is the one API route that runs a subprocess: the catalog is a
yt-dlp flat listing, bounded by ``deps.BACKFILL_LIST_TIMEOUT_SEC`` and
``MAX_BACKFILL_LIMIT``. It departs from "the API performs no processing"
because architecture.md 8.3 wants a synchronous dry-run answer, and a
flat listing is network-bound, not CPU work (owner decision; moving it
to a worker is #115). A dry run (the default) writes nothing; a real run
answers 202 when it enqueued at least one job, else 200.

get.description: Liveness plus queue depth by kind and state; 503 when the database is not usable.
A page of ``jobs``, newest first (#44). ``payload`` is never exposed.

post.description:
Revive one ``dead`` job in place: same id, ``attempts`` reset to 0 (#44).

One conditional ``UPDATE`` (``PostgresQueue.retry_dead``) decides and
writes the new state together, so a concurrent change can only ever be
caught, never missed. The one log line, ``ops.job_retried``, is emitted
only on success; a refusal writes nothing and leaves no trace beyond the
response.

get.description:
Videos whose preferred transcript matches ``q``, most relevant first.

The body never echoes ``q``, and the log line records only its length.
Any database error is a 503 (``deps.get_read_conn``).
The library, newest published first; ``total`` counts every match.
One video, its status, best transcript (D2) and latest analysis.
Every analysis run of the video, newest first (D7).

post.description:
Force a fresh analysis of a stored transcript at the current version (#101).

Only enqueues: the analyzer (#33) does the work. The request has no body
and nothing in it changes the payload, priority or key.

200.description: An active forced job was reused

409.description: No transcript yet, or an analysis is already running

get.description:
One analysis of the video as a self-contained page (D12c).

The latest by default; ``analysis_id`` picks one run of this video (#109).
The page comes from ``render.render_analysis_html``; this handler only
reads and sets the security headers. No 404 echoes the ids, and another
video's analysis id answers like an unknown one.
One page of the best transcript's segments (D2, architecture.md 9).
